name: propulsion-site-template
description: Propulsion master website template v2: craft theme, one client.json per client, static output.

scripts.build:all: for c in test-bathrooms darren-reference test-roofing slate-gutters; do node build.mjs $c --quiet && node build.mjs $c --preview --quiet || exit 1; done
scripts.images: node scripts/gen-placeholders.mjs test-bathrooms && node scripts/gen-placeholders.mjs test-roofing
scripts.qa:jsonld: for c in test-bathrooms darren-reference test-roofing; do node scripts/check-jsonld.mjs dist/$c && node scripts/check-jsonld.mjs dist/$c--preview clients/$c || exit 1; done
scripts.qa:axe: for c in test-bathrooms darren-reference test-roofing; do node scripts/axe.mjs $c || exit 1; done
scripts.qa:gate-a: for c in test-bathrooms darren-reference test-roofing; do node scripts/gate-a.mjs $c || exit 1; done
scripts.qa:browser: for c in test-bathrooms darren-reference test-roofing; do node scripts/browser-checks.mjs $c || exit 1; done
scripts.qa:routes: for c in test-bathrooms darren-reference test-roofing; do node scripts/routes.mjs $c || exit 1; done
scripts.qa:lighthouse: for c in test-bathrooms darren-reference test-roofing; do node scripts/lighthouse.mjs $c || exit 1; done
scripts.qa:all: npm run build:all && npm run qa:jsonld && npm run qa:routes && npm run qa:axe && npm run qa:gate-a && npm run qa:browser && npm run test:guards && npm run test:browser && npm run qa:lighthouse
